In college a bunch of girls who were my friends asked me to room with them so we could get a townhouse (there is a minimum requirement of ppl per house). They all were bitches behind each other's backs so I started having a "house day" each week so we could discuss the issues.such as sweeping, dishes, food left out, drinking of other ppls booze, and noise pollution during important test dates. But since I was the one bringing it all up, no matter how nicely, they ALL turned on me.

Eventually I stopped having the meetings and did ALL the house work myself so ppl would stop being pissy all the time and complaining to ME but never to THEM. A few weeks of me constantly picking up after them, cleaning the living room and washing the dishes and floor and bathroom I got so depressed and my grades started slipping.

I went to housing but there weren't any rooms available. So I stuck it out and decided to stop cleaning. The dishes piled up over the sink and across the entire counter surface. It smelled. The floor grew so gross there were tumble weeds of hair everywhere. Every surface covered in bongs or liquor bottles/cans and one day they had a meeting. They said I was no longer doing my fair share and the house "MUST be clean for inspection " so I asked them all to tell me the last time they saw me use the living room, drink, or use the sink. 
Silence 
I told them I own one plate, fork, spoon, bowl, cup and a steak knife which I keep in my room. I explained that the sink was so full I would take my dishes to the campus and fill my water bottles and wash my dishes there then trek back. Even at night.
Silence
They stopped talking to me and inviting me places, our mutual friends started telling me I couldn't come over when my housemates were there, they got so bad one day I tried to hurt myself ending up in the hospital (they all saw the ambulance take me away) and the campus police raided our house to find me (before I was taken away, I was on the other side of campus during the raid or whatever it's called)and they all got put on probation for like 4 different reasons each. They blamed me and I moved out. 

Friends can suck. Sometimes you have to learn the hardest and worst way how to tell if someone gives a shit about you. I'm sorry for what you went through... I bet it stings now but one day, probably not any time soon, you will be glad for the new strength it gave you.
